notes.title: Added a Difficulty Option
notes.content:
You can now set the game difficulty.
The speed and vision range of enemies will change according to the selected difficulty.

Set the frame rate cap to 60fps.
This should make the game run more smoothly and stably.

Apologies to those who experienced dizziness or ear pain. 
We have fixed the following issues by adjusting the initial settings in the options:
- Fixed the issue of extreme spinning at the start of the game 
- Fixed the issue of the volume being 100 times the normal maximum at the start of the game
